mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS room_type_id, r.hotel_id, h.organization_id, r.name AS room_name, p.title AS hotel_name, r.ical_token FROM room_types r JOIN hotel_profiles h ON h.id = r.hotel_id JOIN places p ON p.id = h.place_id
